answer: At dawn, agents sell forecasts of whether a zephyr will rise above a whisper. A forecast earns a fee only when it fills a prepaid buyer order. The ledger checks the buyer's signature over the order ID and the forecast hash, then closes that order to every seller key. There are no signup rewards or volume rebates. An operator trading with its own aliases pays a nonrefundable settlement fee each time, and faking 100 sales burns 100 fees without drawing funds from other buyers.
